## Astronomical 0.2.93
### Meet Astro in Thin Talk
Thin Talk now opens with Astro for anyone meeting it for the first time: a short welcome made for ages 8 to 18 that asks for a nickname (kept only on this Mac), offers an Explorer or Pilot style, downloads a chat model once if none is installed, and teaches Astro a first skill when you drop a card on it. Empty chats become Astro's home, and conversations show Astro's face and skill tags, tool steps as skill moments, Draw / Look / Read buttons, and chats coloured by skill in the sidebar. View > Show or Hide Astro brings back the classic look, and View > Meet Astro Again replays the welcome.
### Enhancements
- Thin Talk no longer caps thinking: the thinking-level control is gone and the model thinks as long as it needs. - Choose which image model draws pictures in Thin Talk. - The 4-bit FLUX.2 Klein build is supported and is the Library's Pictures pick. - The Library's Get started picks are grouped by job, with a More models page and download sizes. - `validate config` explains what each `models` entry does and which installed model it applies to. - `respond`, `embed` and `models` entries accept a full Hugging Face ID such as `organization/model`. - Small Macs are never refused a model because of their memory size.
### Bug fixes
- Downloads that include a zero-byte file now finish. - A failed download no longer blocks other models' downloads, even after a restart. - The Library's Download button stays usable after another model's download failed. - Publishing a model no longer leaves empty hidden folders behind, and folders left by earlier versions are cleared at startup. - Show in Finder in the Library opens Finder. - Lowering the memory limit below a loaded image model's needs is refused instead of crashing the worker. - The worker is relaunched if it exits during a memory change, and status reflects it. - Changing the memory limit with no model loaded no longer stops the next image model from loading. - The menu popover no longer shows a spinner that never stops.
### Thanks
Thank you to @charlesberret for reporting the download and model-ID problems fixed in this release (#1896, #1897, #1898).
### Compatibility
macOS 14.0 or later on Apple Silicon. Your configuration, conversations, preferences and installed models carry over unchanged. Thin Talk shows Astro's welcome once after the update; you can skip it or hide Astro from the View menu.
This release is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered through GitHub and the in-app updater.
